steps.content: The world in front of you starts to fall apart, glitching and flickering like a broken machine.
There Eleven stands at the core, with the world constantly morphing behind her. Black and white, an office, a studio, the rooftop.
They appear and freeze, glitch, fragment, morph, and break apart, like a repeated portrayal of Eleven's mental state.
Eleven... Eleven, snap out of it...! Don't be overwhelmed by all this!! You know the right thing to do!
What she failed to do, lies within your grasp!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: What's my role in this... How should I proceed... I believed escaping from such a world... would change everything here...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: We're united in our repression, our passion, our collapses, and our despair...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: What keeps her here, what fuels her spirit, is her passion for her work, her cherished connection with those dear listeners who share their souls with her...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: She genuinely helped those people, shared her passion with the world...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: But ultimately, she was broken... pigeonholed, her authenticity reduced to a mere facade...
The rooftop view halts behind Eleven, with the icy wind heralding a night devoid of stars, unfolding before you.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I'm at my limit... Drained, tricked, never encountering anyone's genuine side...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: These feelings are relentless, always reviving, no matter what I try, or who I turn to for assistance.
Eleven's voice begins to blend with another; similar yet distinct, and you can tell them apart.
Are you the real Ghost Call...?
Eleven does bear a striking resemblance to you, but she's not you, and she has no desire to be you.
Eleven, let me through.
The wall of air, imprisoning in nature, lingers around you. Eleven starts to meld with that sorrowful ghost, convincing herself they are one and the same.
Shackles emerge from the palm of your hand, clinging to the ether, morphing into an enormous barrier of thorns.
Eleven disregards your plea, steadily moving to the rooftop's brink. The vintage terminal falls from her grasp, hitting the ground.
The indicator light trembles briefly, mixed with a buzz of electricity, whispering ominously from its interior.
Eleven, recall those words! Are you willing to turn into yet another Ghost Call?
Your similarity lies only in your passion, your affection, not in anything else—
One step at a time.
Finally, Eleven perches on the modest barrier, takes a deep breath, and makes the daring leap—

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Hmm...
Eleven, this makes twice I've come to your rescue.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Why did I...
After losing a friend who was all heart, I'm not ready to lose another.
You are just a few strides from Eleven. In your haste, you end up kicking that vintage terminal along.
There it lies, under the wall, sporadically crackling to life, emitting sounds from some mysterious origin.

steps.speaker: Unknown Voice A
steps.content: "Hey, did you catch today's lunchtime buzz on social media?"

steps.speaker: Unknown Voice B
steps.content: "Sure did! 'Be your own definition of confident.' Really cool, right?"

steps.speaker: Unknown Voice C
steps.content: "However, her radio show always seems to attract bizarre callers. Better to avoid it, rather than add to the chaos."
You see, your voice actually does resonate with them.
But if you don't step up soon, you're just going to drive them away again, all by yourself.
Do you actually want that? Deep down... you love this work, right?
The hand you and the shackles have grasped is gradually forming a fist. In the corner of your eye, the vintage terminal and the rooftop are slowly turning to dust, unveiling a brilliant white light.
But, for now, the most pressing matter...
You're in control here. If that strength finds its way back to you, can it first help lift you up...
I'm at my limit here...
In an instant whoosh, every image disintegrates into dust, and there you and Eleven are, softly set down on the ground, as if held in the air.
And from the terminal, through the billowing dust, a small orb shrouded in black mist drifts towards Eleven.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I've been looking for you forever... Were you always this little?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: You're quite the tough one, huh? Seems like there's no way to completely erase you...
The orb gives a little jump, then gradually merges into Eleven's heart.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Mania power... Does it really evoke such an exhilarating feeling?
I doubt that...
From what I understand, there's just one thing in the world that remains indestructible, no matter how much it's tormented, suppressed, or what tactics are used against it.
And it also gives you a real rush.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Then... what could it be?
"Growth" and "Metamorphosis"—the personal journey of evolving in every aspect... It inspires you, energizes you, and keeps you... eager to press on.
I think, these persistent powers, are probably born from a refusal to surrender.

Since coming back from that world, you've noticed, haven't you? This place didn't get any better just because you found your original motivation again. So, you decided to wipe out all evidence of Call at 3 AM?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Yeah... I believed... it was better if they were never there.
What you truly feel inside must be different.
Or else, would a few words from me have been enough to bring you down from that rooftop?
Eleven flashes a smile of relief and struggles to her feet. Just then, it is as if her face momentarily transforms, mirroring the "Ghost Call."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: The voice deep within me... disagrees, obviously, but the truth is, I'm not going to be working here any longer.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Therefore, Chief, my thanks to you—and also, I have a favor to ask.
Why don't we talk about it when we're back at the Bureau? We're all worn out.
By the way, I spotted something in your pocket earlier. The sandwich—make sure to eat it, okay?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, we're almost done with the job you gave us.
Ah, thanks. You're always such a rock.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: As for the last Mania world issue, we've verified that the Sinner Eleven has fully recovered her powers, and her M-value readings are consistent. Assuming no more blips on her record, we might look into reducing her monitoring level.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: And there's more—the higher-ups have approved Eleven for one last radio gig. The TV folks are hesitant to keep her as their host, but they can't ignore the buzz it'll create. They've said yes, mostly out of respect for you.
She produces a stack of papers and places them in front of you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But, they've got a laundry list of demands. All these papers need your once-over and signature.
Okay then, let me take a look. How many "soul-selling" agreements do I need to sign here... Any loopholes I can wriggle through...?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: That quick, huh? Anytime I've put in a request to the top brass, it's always been at least a week or two before hearing back... Looks like you carry quite the clout.
Eleven appears a bit taken aback when you tell her that her earlier request has been given the green light.

options: Guess I'm still the "Chief" around here.

choices.text: Guess I'm still the "Chief" around here.

steps.content: We're nearly there; that room up ahead is the one.

As you swing the door open, you're met with a starkly ordinary room, just a table and chairs in their simplest form. The only thing that stands out is on the table—an incredibly basic recording setup.
But this is the limit of what I could pull off. The gear is all bare-bones. I just hope you're not too disappointed.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: No, no, thank you! This is all I need. After all, for my broadcast... it's my voice that really matters.
Eleven is visibly delighted. She gives you a grateful nod before settling softly in front of the mic.

Initially, they were hesitant to approve, but as the final farewell for "Call at 3 AM," it carried substantial appeal. They've laid out a few conditions, though: First, you must remain under the constant supervision of MBCC.
Second, no more use of your powers, and even the calls you answer must be pre-screened by them.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: What's the third condition?

Well, thirdly, as the chief of MBCC, you had to sign a mountain of guarantee agreements. Took you three whole days to wade through that sea of paperwork. But hey, this isn't the time for gripes, right?
The last part—I'll be stepping in as the producer, personally supervising the production of the last episode.

We're going scriptless for this one. Whether it's a score to settle or a goodbye to say, just go with your gut—as long as it's within the bounds I consider acceptable. And if you're not feeling it, remember, we can walk out of here whenever.
You've handed over the reins of choice completely to Eleven.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Alright, thanks.
Eleven gives a cunning grin, clearly getting the hint in your words. The Bureau's rules are much looser compared to the TV station's "norms."
You casually slide into the chair opposite the host, giving her a playful wink.
Just a heads-up, though—if things get too heated, I'll be there to cool things down.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Got it.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Ah—er, cough cough...
Eleven clears her throat and, with her voice finely tuned, starts with the well-known intro.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Maybe you've wrapped up a busy day, or perhaps you're still mulling over the fatigue of today..."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Welcome to the last broadcast of Call at 3 AM. I'm your host, Eleven."
Her tone is calm and soothing, but her hands are firmly clasped together on the desk.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: This is an unplanned special episode. Call at 3 AM is usually for listening, but given this unique chance, let me start by telling you a story from a friend.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: She was... not the strongest. Her voice, lacking conviction, was often overpowered by others' words, causing her great distress.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Thanks to a friend's assistance, she gradually reclaimed her voice. However, deep down, she knew she wasn't yet resilient. Terrified of engaging with others' emotions, she retreated when she saw that her endeavors didn't improve the situation.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: She even considered shattering what she loved... What worth is there in someone so frail?
Eleven's tone is soft, almost tender, lacking any hint of aggression, but...
(A quiet studio, interrupted by a ringing phone)

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Ah, we've got a call coming through. Let's take a moment to listen to what our audience has to say.

steps.speaker: Listener A
steps.content: Hey there, is this Miss Eleven? Oh, great, I've been looking for you everywhere since you went off-air, glad I finally got you!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Thanks a lot, but this is actually our last show. I—

steps.speaker: Listener A
steps.content: You can't imagine how dull things were without you around! I was starting to think you couldn't handle a bit of teasing! Just a few barbs, and off you go into hiding?

steps.speaker: Listener A
steps.content: And now, turning your final episode into a big spectacle! Hey! I just had to make a call...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: What's your reason for calling? To keep getting a kick out of berating others? Need someone to bash without expecting a fight back?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: My soft-spoken approach to everyone is about fostering meaningful dialogue, not to act as a defenseless target for your harsh words, a doll to absorb your verbal lashings.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Next time you ring us up, maybe you'll get lucky and not have a ghost on the line.

steps.speaker: Listener A
steps.content: You!!!
The caller on the other end freezes, speechless, then quickly slams the phone down. However, another call is already barreling through.

steps.speaker: Listener B
steps.content: Ah, got you on the line! Hey, let me remind you, the listeners are the ones who keep you going! What's with the attitude?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: The way you come at me decides how I'll respond to you. Got it?
Eleven's smile becomes softer, and you can't help but feel it's a shame she's not on television. You'd love for others to see Eleven's "gentle" smile in person.

steps.speaker: Listener B
steps.content: So, you're the radio's "star host," huh? What a joke! You can't even handle the basic requests of your audience!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I listen to requests that make sense, nothing over the top. On my better days, I might bend the rules a tad, but it's up to me to decide if I'll listen, not you.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Before you start bossing others around, take a good look at yourself and see if you can walk the talk, Mr. Perfect Listener. If you can't handle a bit of straight talk from me, how are you going to handle life's tougher knocks?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I get it, you're all about the thrill. If you haven't already been left "without a comeback" in your day-to-day or at work, or maybe you're yet to experience it, then tune into Eleven's radio. Get ready for a one-of-a-kind show that'll knock your socks off in ways you can't even begin to fathom.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Don't worry, a show like this will definitely hit the trending charts!

One after another, calls flood in from former listeners, the curious onlookers, and the regulars of the radio, all eager to share their "regards" and "blessings" with Eleven. And Eleven, she's right there, answering each call, echoing their sentiments.

No calls are being dropped at the radio station. You let out a sigh—it is clear they are chasing popularity above everything else. And Eleven, in her current state, is a master at playing this game of views and clicks.

As you see the topic continuously popping up on the trending feeds, a soft laugh escapes you. You settle into your chair and pick up a private line to call in—the barrage of calls is throwing Eleven's Mania abilities off balance. It is time for you to intervene.

options: With the phone pressed to your ear,

choices.text: With the phone pressed to your ear,

steps.content: Good evening, dear host. Any chance you could lend an ear to my woes?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: ...Absolutely, I'm all ears for what you have to say.
Ahem... First off, I owe you an apology. I sort of "pulled some strings" to get this call through. But don't worry, it's not going on air. This is a secure line, inside the Bureau.

In my role as the Chief of the Bureau, I'm responsible for keeping all the Sinners in check. But on a personal note, as your friend, I want nothing more than for you to grow up unburdened, healthy, and really thrive in loving something.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: So... would you believe me if I said that I actually still have a soft spot for this job?
You know, work might just be that little bit of rebellion most of us manage against the world, our way of saying we're not ready to go quietly just yet.
Just a touch of personal fulfillment.
The things you're vocal about, the things you're pushing against, it kind of looks like you're not valuing your own strengths, your own position, almost like you're playing up for the spotlight.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: However... this is how I show my devotion—you've helped me learn and grow.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: If the situation hasn't gotten any better, then it's time for the new, evolved me to step up and make a difference! I guess, that's what my "power" is aiming for.
True, this is exactly what they wanted.
Even though the hot topics are mostly filled with insults, it's clear to see that a good number of the conversations don't echo their sentiment.
They're thankful for Eleven's voice; it gave them power, bravery, and the drive to make a difference. They're also grateful to Eleven for encouraging them to push back against the nasty chatter.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: After this, there's no way I can go back to being the same old radio host. But I'm confident there will be someone even better ready to fill these shoes.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: However... given that there's always a shadowy side to things, why not keep up my role in Call at 3 AM?
Hmm? Seems like you've got some plans brewing for what's next... Ah, but remember, that's only if you stick around here for detention.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I know, Chief.
Eleven says, her fingers lightly brushing the microphone while she browses the latest online buzz.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Those real, powerful, emotionally charged voices—the ones I love the most—they've been here all along. Thanks for reviving them, for sharing them with me, helping me grasp their true potency.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: And yeah, I'm a bit selfish; I long to keep hearing voices like these...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: This program, which mercilessly mangles language, is all the rage now... Guess that's enough fuel for it to keep running, huh?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Maybe you've wrapped up a busy day, or perhaps you're still mulling over the fatigue and scoldings of today..."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Take it easy... sweetheart, Call at 3 AM will forever be a part of your nights, a constant companion in the darkness."

steps.speaker: Same.
steps.content: "A big thank you to everyone for sticking with Call at 3 AM. This isn't a farewell; it's a pact for an eventual comeback."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "In this never-ending night, under the faint glow of lights, I'll always be here... hearing out your voices."
